utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, everybody. Madam Registrar, could you kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-04-74-A, the Prosecutor versus Jadranko Prlic, Bruno Stojic, Slobodan Praljak, Milivoj Petkovic, Valentin Coric, and Berislav Pusic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Before we continue, I want to make sure that the appellants can follow the proceedings in a language they can understand. Mr. Prlic. THE APPELLANT PRLIC: Yes, Mr. President, I'm able to follow. Good afternoon to all.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Stojic. THE APPELLANT STOJIC: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Everything is all right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Praljak. THE APPELLANT PRALJAK: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I can follow. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Petkovic. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] Good day. I can follow. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Coric. THE APPELLANT CORIC: [Interpretation] Your Honours, good afternoon. Everything is all right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And good afternoon to all of you as well. I move on to check the appearances. Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAINBOECK
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Mario Hainboeck for the Prosecution, with Senior Appeals Counsel Douglas Stringer, Appeals Counsel Matthew Gillett and our Case Manager Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Before calling appearances for the Defence, I need to note that on the 1st of August of this year, counsel for Mr. Pusic requested to attend this Status Conference via video-conference link from Sarajevo. Mr. Pusic has provided consent for the Status Conference to be held in his absence and has not provided any objections to his counsel's participation in this way. This request is hereby granted. I move straight away to appearances. For Mr. Prlic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Good afternoon to everyone in and around the courtroom. Michael Karnavas for Dr. Jadranko Prlic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you and good afternoon. Mr. Stojic, appearances for Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Attorney-at-law Senka Nozica appearing for Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, counsel. Good afternoon. Appearances for Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU-IVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau-Ivanovic for Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, and good afternoon. Appearances for Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon. For General Petkovic, Attorney-at-law Vesna Alaburic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. And appearances for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Drazen Plavec, co-counsel, and our legal consultant, Dan Ivetic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And I look towards Sarajevo. Mr. Ibrisimovic, can you follow?

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] Good afternoon. I can follow. I can follow, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right, okay. And you're still appearing for Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. This Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. This rule requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the last Status Conference has been held for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody. A Status Conference serves two primary purposes: First, it allows the appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions and for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical condition of the detained persons. Second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of the case as well as to inform the general public. I will now like to inquire into the status of the detention conditions and health situation of the appellants. If any of the appellants wish this discussion to take place in a closed session, please let me know immediately. Does any one of you wish to have this discussion proceed in a closed session? No? Okay. So I start with you, Mr. Prlic. We're talking of your status of detention and health situation. Is there anything that you would like to raise with me today? THE APPELLANT PRLIC: No, Mr. President. I have no issues to be addressed on this occasion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. I thank you, Mr. Prlic. Mr. Stojic. THE APPELLANT STOJIC: [Interpretation] Everything is fine, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Praljak. THE APPELLANT PRALJAK: [Interpretation] I have no mental or physical problems. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Petkovic. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] It's all right, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Coric. THE APPELLANT CORIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have nothing to say.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Now, counsel for Mr. Pusic, Mr. Ibrisimovic. Are you aware of any complaints that your client would like to raise with me?

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] No, Your Honour. He has nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. I now move to the recent procedural history, and I shall up date you on the case. The appeals hearing in this case, as you know, took place between 20 and 28 March of this year. The Appeals Chamber will pronounce its judgement by November. No specific date has been set, and the date for judgement will be announced in due course. There have been three public filings by the Appeals Chamber since the previous Status Conference which was held, as you remember, on the 3rd of May. The first is a filing dated the 4th of July of this year, when we issued the Appeals Chamber decision on application by the Republic of Croatia for reconsideration of its decision of 18 July 2016 denying leave to appear as amicus curiae. The second is the original Scheduling Order for this Status Conference which was filed on the 12th of June, 2017. And lastly, the Amended Scheduling Order for this Status Conference filed on the 2nd of August, where we amended the time, basically. I now come to the last part of this Status Conference; namely, I'm going to deal and ask for any issues which the parties would like to raise with me. I'll start with the Prosecution. I don't know who is -- yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAINBOECK
utterances.text: Nothing from the Prosecution, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. And on the part of the Defence? I'll start with --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Nothing, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We have nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU-IVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nothing, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. ALABURIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We have no issues, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nothing, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] We have nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So just for the general information, we are proceeding with the drafting of the judgement and constant deliberations, and as I told you before, we expect to hand down the judgement by November of this year. You will be notified in due course about the exact date which has still got to be established. Thank you. Since there are no other matters to be raised, I thank the parties for their attendance today and adjourn these proceedings.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
